About.headline: Built for the way Malaysians drive.
About.lede: UEL — Unique Excellent Lubricant — is the official Malaysian distributor of the UEL brand of engine, industrial and gear oils. We work with workshops, fleet operators and industrial buyers across the country.
About.storyP1: UEL was founded on a simple idea: engine oil should be specified by what it does under the bonnet, not by what it looks like on a shelf. Our ULTRA range is formulated for the loads, temperatures and traffic patterns Malaysian engines actually face — long idles in standstill traffic, humidity that never lets up, and roads that punish anything underprotected.
About.storyP2: Every UEL formulation is built on additive packages benchmarked against OEM service-fill specifications. We document viscosity grade, API class, OEM approvals and pack size on every bottle, because the workshop fitting it should not have to guess.
About.storyP3: We are headquartered in Kuala Lumpur and supply through a growing network of partner workshops nationwide — the people who actually pour the oil. If you run a workshop and want to stock UEL, our distribution team is one WhatsApp message away.
About.row1Heading: Base oil + additive package, dosed to spec.
About.row1Body: Each grade is blended from API-graded base stocks paired with an additive package matched to the application — anti-wear, anti-oxidant, viscosity index improvers, detergents. We don't ship a formulation we couldn't justify on the spec sheet.
About.row2Heading: Every batch tested before it leaves the line.
About.row2Body: Viscosity at 40°C and 100°C, total base number, flash point — every batch is sampled and verified against its target spec. Out-of-spec batches don't get bottled, full stop.
About.row3Body: ULTRA bottles are HDPE-formed in oxblood with full-body labels rated for direct sun and humidity. Tamper-evident caps mean what's printed on the bottle is what's inside it when your workshop opens it.
About.row4Body: Lot codes are printed on every container, traceable back to blend, base oil source and QC sample. If anything is ever off, we know exactly where to look.
About.certBody: UEL formulations reference industry-standard specifications. Detailed claims for each product are on the individual product pages.
